notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import quad
import math

def ut(mu, p, fn, alpha=1.0, beta=2.0, kappa=0.0):
    c=alpha**2*(1+kappa)
    x=np.array([mu,mu+np.sqrt(c*p),mu-np.sqrt(c*p)])
    wm=np.array([1-1/c,.5/c,.5/c]);wc=wm.copy();wc[0]+=1-alpha**2+beta
    y=fn(x);mean=float(wm@y)
    return x,wm,wc,y,mean,float(wc@((y-mean)**2)),float(wc@((x-mu)*(y-mean)))

notebooks.title: UKF校正与近似边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.integrate import quad
import math

def ut(mu, p, fn, alpha=1.0, beta=2.0, kappa=0.0):
    c=alpha**2*(1+kappa)
    x=np.array([mu,mu+np.sqrt(c*p),mu-np.sqrt(c*p)])
    wm=np.array([1-1/c,.5/c,.5/c]);wc=wm.copy();wc[0]+=1-alpha**2+beta
    y=fn(x);mean=float(wm@y)
    return x,wm,wc,y,mean,float(wc@((y-mean)**2)),float(wc@((x-mu)*(y-mean)))

def reference(mu,p,r,z,kind):
    h=lambda x:x*x if kind=="square" else x
    log=lambda x:-(x-mu)**2/(2*p)-(z-h(x))**2/(2*r)
    roots=np.roots([2*p,0,r-2*p*z,-r*mu]) if kind=="square" else np.array([(r*mu+p*z)/(r+p)])
    modes=sorted(float(t.real) for t in roots if abs(t.imag)<1e-9);shift=max(log(t) for t in modes)
    cuts=[-np.inf]+sorted(set(modes))+[np.inf]
    def I(n):
        return sum(quad(lambda x:x**n*math.exp(log(x)-shift),a,b,epsabs=1e-12,epsrel=1e-12)[0] for a,b in zip(cuts,cuts[1:]))
    mass=I(0);m=I(1)/mass
    return m,I(2)/mass-m*m

for mu,p,r,z,kind in [(2,.25,1,5,"square"),(2,.25,4,5,"square"),(-2,.25,1,5,"square"),(0,1,.25,4,"square"),(2,.25,1,5,"linear")]:
    h=lambda x:x*x if kind=="square" else x
    point=ut(mu,p,h);zh,v,C=point[4:];S=v+r;K=C/S;mean=mu+K*(z-zh);var=p-C*C/S
    H=2*mu if kind=="square" else 1;hm=h(mu);Ke=p*H/(H*H*p+r);me=mu+Ke*(z-hm);ve=p-p*p*H*H/(H*H*p+r)
    ref,refv=reference(mu,p,r,z,kind)
    print("case_update",mu,p,r,z,kind,"zh_S_C_K_innovation",zh,S,C,K,z-zh,"UKF",mean,var,"EKF",me,ve,"reference",ref,refv)
    print("absolute_errors_UKF_EKF_mean_variance",abs(mean-ref),abs(me-ref),abs(var-refv),abs(ve-refv))
    if kind=="linear":assert np.allclose([mean,var,me,ve,ref,refv],[2.6,.2,2.6,.2,2.6,.2],atol=1e-12)
    if mu==0:assert K==0 and var==1 and abs(refv-3.841876221594494)<1e-9
print("posterior_reference_checked")

# Closed Gaussian moments are independent of sigma-point summation.
for mu,p in [(2,.25),(-2,.25),(0,1)]:
    point=ut(mu,p,lambda x:x*x)
    exact=[mu*mu+p,4*mu*mu*p+2*p*p,2*mu*p]
    print("analytic_square_moments",mu,p,exact)
    assert np.allclose(point[4:],exact,atol=1e-12)
